# OpenView IPTV

> OpenView IPTV is a media player app for Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV and Android phones and tablets (Android 7.1 or newer). It is only a player: it does not host, provide or sell any channels or content. Users add their own M3U/M3U8 playlist URL or Xtream Codes account.

- Free to download and use. An optional Premium licence unlocks multiple sources at once, recordings, reminders and backup. Lifetime works on up to 5 devices, annual on up to 2.
- Features: EPG program guide, recordings and reminders (Premium), backup and restore (Premium), interface in 10 languages, TV-first remote navigation.
- Playlists and credentials stay on the user's device.
- Install from Google Play. On Fire TV, open the Downloader app and type openviewiptv.com/tv, or sideload the APK.
- There is no iPhone or App Store version.
